dedupe_keys.name: tm open buildings manually drawn building outlines with roof attributes for 12 philippine cities

description: TM Open Buildings is a dataset of manually drawn building outlines with annotations on building and roof attributes, released by Thinking Machines Data Science with support from the Lacuna Fund and contributed to OpenStreetMap. It covers selected 250 by 250 metre tiles in twelve cities: Dagupan, Palayan, Navotas, Mandaluyong, Muntinlupa, Legazpi, Tacloban, Iloilo, Mandaue, Cagayan de Oro, Davao and Zamboanga, chosen to focus on residential areas across urban, coastal, riparian and agricultural terrain, and every structure within a tile was drawn. Outlines were traced on Mapbox Satellite Streets imagery of August and September 2023, and attributes were checked with HOT Asia Pacific, community architects of the Philippine Action for Community-led Shelter Initiatives and street-level views. Access: one GeoJSON file on HDX, also contributed to OpenStreetMap and Kaggle. Licence: Open Database License; free. Caveats: the imagery mosaic combines sources with different capture dates, so outlines may not reflect the latest situation, and only sample tiles are covered, not whole cities. Simulation uses are training and validation data for building and roof-type detection, and roof and building attributes for typhoon and flood vulnerability models in informal and coastal settlements. Related records: Google Open Buildings and the Philippines pre-disaster indicators.
